localizedValues.name: Backcountry
localizedValues.description: Permit Registration allows for overnight camping at Quiniscoe Lake campground outside of peak season. Backcountry Reservations are required at Quiniscoe Lake campground from late June to mid-September. Access to this campground is hike-in only. Vehicle access into the park is not available. The Lakeview and Wall Creek (Centennial) trails are open. Follow all signs in-park, as some areas within the park remain closed due to damage from the 2023 Crater Creek fire.

localizedValues.name: Quiniscoe Lake
localizedValues.description: Quiniscoe Lake backcountry campground is located in the Core Area of Cathedral Park and is situated on Quiniscoe lake. This 30-site campground has earth-filled tent platforms, food caches, fire rings and pit toilets. Backcountry reservations are mandatory at this campground from the end of June until mid-September. Permit registration is required outside of peak season. There is a shuttle service to Quiniscoe Lake, that is operated by Cathedral Lakes Lodge and reservations can be made at cathedrallakes.ca. A confirmed backcountry camping reservation is required, prior to booking a shuttle reservation. Exceptions to BC Parks reservation refund policies will not be granted due to a change in plans related to the shuttle service.
